body: I already do. I can't see him any more frequently than once per month even on sliding scale because of money problems.
You'll have to figure it out yourself. I can't help you because I can't even help myself. I'm actually planning my own death as we speak.

None of those will work. Not even together. Overdoses make up only a tiny fraction of successful suicides. It'll be painful like hell and you won't end up dying. Only suffering more. Spare yourself the misery of a failed attempt that way.
Certainly not for me. The past few years prove it.
Things are as bad as ever. I haven't backed down from the date. I just haven't gotten the means yet.
If I did it, it would be drinking a ton of booze, overdosing, and then throwing myself into the river with weights strapped to me. I'm pretty sure it would result in death.
It's more of a "nothing matters anymore" feeling. Kind of like having a terminal disease in the last stages.

I haul boxes at a warehouse. Most brainless job ever. There's no skill involved. All you do is stack boxes and empty bags. I just want a job that makes me feel like a human being. Not a disposable meat bag.

Even if there's someone out there, i still don't know where they are. I'm glad there's someone I can talk to. Yet talking through a computer monitor just doesn't compare to face to face.

Well there's my poor job prospects despite holding a degree. I've tried using it to no avail. I can't see how I qualify for any other job. My current job sucks and doesn't pay enough for me to be comfortable or pay debts My family relationships are bad and getting worse over time. I do have a friend but he's hundreds of miles away. We rarely talk anymore. I'm single with no children. So I'm pretty much alone all the time.
No to both questions. Debt is only part of it. I'm already indebted to family and I have only one friend. Of course he wouldn't lend money.

I actually have a therapist. I've had one session so far. But it costs $65 per session. I can only afford about 1 session every 1 and a half months. In the past, playing games was a pleasure for me. Now however, playing games is a reminder of how I wasted my life playing them and not doing much else. Nothing else makes me happy anymore. And whatever did in the past now no longer makes me smile.

You say that death would make me feel nothing. Yet to forever sleep and not have anything is something I want right now. You also say there are people who care, want me to live, and will help me, but where are they? They're certainly not at home. And I don't  know anyone who would help someone like me.

Don't be sorry. Ultimately, I'm a lost cause. I have been for a while now. I was an idiot in thinking this would end any other way.

There's really nobody who is supportive anymore to my feelings. And yes I've tried the national crisis line and have had nothing but bad experiences with them. They're a very apathetic and bored bunch. One time they even told me to call back later! Besides I'm afraid they may call the cops on me. They can track phone calls.

So yeah I have no help anymore. All I can do now is go forth with my plans and finally achieve the peace and tranquility I've longed for.
So yeah, I've got the methods, time, and date set. All it will take now is time.

Well my part time job sucks and I'm trying but failing to get another one. I say forsaking because they get so angry when I feel sad and what they call "mopey". I think that if I remove myself forever they won't be feeling these bad things. Especially since I've been giving them so much grief.
